name: Progress-6
about: Progress-6 (1979-039A), a crewed vehicle (Progress), launched 1979 May 13. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1979 May 21), held fixed
docked to S10382; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
